title: Implement the business-logic function behind the 'Assign Agent' action on the Cr
description: Create a business logic such that if In "Ticket Management" folder within "Create Support Ticket" transaction in "Action" when 'Assign Agent' is clicked that particular ticket must be assigned randomly to an agent whose 'Availability' is Available and 'Status' is Active in "My Agents" transaction under "Agent Ticket Desk" folder. Once the ticket is assigned to a particular agent change the status from 'Open' to 'Assigned'.
